name: SLOOP
summary: Live 4-track groovebox: three synths (ANALOG, FM6, PHASE) and a drum track. Every button is a layer: hold FX for punch-in effects, SEQ for steps (hold a step: note, level, ratchet, nudge, locks, fill), GLO for the mix (mute, solo, fill, tap), SAVE for song sections A–D, SEL for key and chords, EDIT to erase, ARP for note repeat. REC records over the loop.
credits: After SLOOP 2.8 by isod89 / 3dSam (github.com/isod89/sloop-fm1). Re-implemented from its published manual; no SLOOP code. Runs on FM Pocket's built-in engines.
